```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tibble)
```

Table S1. Summary of model features estimated, fixed, or derived in the single-region estimation model (EM).

```{r em-parameters-table}
em_par_table <- tribble(
  ~`Model feature`, ~`Treatment in EM`, ~Notes,
  "Spatial structure", "Fixed",
  "Single-region; no movement or population components.",

  "Mean recruitment", "Estimated",
  "Aggregate mean.",

  "Recruitment deviation SD", "Estimated",
  "IID lognormal recruitment deviations.",

  "Age-2+ deviation SD", "Estimated",
  "IID lognormal age-2+ deviations.",

  "Initial numbers-at-age", "Equilibrium initialization",
  "WHAM equilibrium approach.",

  "Annual fishing mortality by fleet", "Estimated",
  "Commercial and recreational fleets.",

  "Commercial selectivity", "Partly estimated",
  "Ages 1-3 estimated; ages 4-8+ fixed at 1.",

  "Recreational selectivity", "Partly estimated",
  "Ages 1-4 estimated; ages 5-8+ fixed at 1.",

  "Survey selectivity", "Partly estimated",
  "Age 1 estimated; ages 2-8+ fixed at 1.",

  "Survey catchability", "Estimated",
  "Aggregate survey index.",

  "Catch observation error CVs", "Fixed",
  "Commercial = 0.05; recreational = 0.15.",

  "Survey observation error CV", "Fixed",
  "CV = 0.4.",

  "Age-composition ESS", "Fixed",
  "ESS = 50.",

  "Natural mortality", "Fixed",
  "M = 0.4 for all ages.",
  
  "Weight-at-age", "Fixed",
  "Aggregated before fitting EM.",

  "Maturity-at-age", "Fixed",
  "Aggregated before fitting EM.",
  
  "F40% reference point", "Derived",
  "Calculated from each EM fit."
)

kable(
  em_par_table,
  format = "latex",
  booktabs = TRUE,
  escape = TRUE,
  align = c("l", "l", "l")
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("hold_position"),
    font_size = 8,
    full_width = FALSE
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "4cm") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "3.5cm") %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "6cm")
```
